summary: The PR addresses an IndexError in export_text when the tree has only one feature but introduces a potential issue with undefined features.

issues.description: The fix does not handle cases where tree_.feature contains _tree.TREE_UNDEFINED values other than the root node, which might still lead to incorrect behavior.
There are no additional tests added to verify the behavior when tree_.feature contains _tree.TREE_UNDEFINED values, especially in non-root nodes.
